title: Follow the Perturbed Leader for Linear Bandits: $\sqrt{T}$ Regret over General Convex Sets
abstract: arXiv:2610.17818v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We give the first adversarial linear bandit algorithm based on Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) that achieves $\sqrt{T}$ regret over general convex action sets. Our algorithm attains $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d^{5/4}\sqrt{T})$ regret using only linear optimization oracles, and the near-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{T})$ regret when an optimal-design exploration distribution is further available. This improves on the $T^{2/3}$ regret of the FTPL algorithm of Dani and Hayes (2006) for general convex sets, and generalizes the $\sqrt{T}$ regret of L\'evy et al. (2026) over two special action sets (hypercube and Euclidean ball). Compared to previous oracle-efficient linear bandit algorithms based on continuous exponential weights, the FTPL approach generally has better computational efficiency, and is much simpler to implement. translated_title: 线性赌博机的扰动跟随领导者算法：一般凸集上的 $\sqrt{T}$ 遗憾
translated_abstract: 我们提出了首个基于扰动跟随领导者（Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader, FTPL）的对抗性线性赌博机算法，该算法在一般凸动作集上实现了 $\sqrt{T}$ 遗憾。我们的算法仅使用线性优化预言机即可达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d^{5/4}\sqrt{T})$ 的遗憾；当进一步可获得最优设计探索分布时，遗憾可达到接近最优的 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{T})$。这改进了 Dani 和 Hayes（2006）的 FTPL 算法在一般凸集上 $T^{2/3}$ 的遗憾，并将 Lévy 等人（2026）在两个特殊动作集（超立方体和欧几里得球）上的 $\sqrt{T}$ 遗憾结果进行了推广。与之前基于连续指数权重的预言机高效线性赌博机算法相比，FTPL 方法通常具有更好的计算效率，且实现起来要简单得多。关键的算法要素是一个能适应估计奖励的扰动分布。
tldr: 本文提出了首个基于FTPL的对抗性线性赌博机算法，通过一个适应估计奖励的扰动分布，在一般凸动作集上实现了 $\sqrt{T}$ 遗憾，改进了此前 $T^{2/3}$ 的遗憾界，同时比连续指数权重方法具有更好的计算效率和更简单的实现。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first FTPL-based adversarial linear bandit algorithm that achieves $\sqrt{T}$ regret over general convex action sets via a perturbation distribution adapted to estimated rewards, improving the prior $T^{2/3}$ bound while offering better computational efficiency and simpler implementation than continuous exponential weights methods.
